---
title: "Our native garden"
---

If you're here, you've probably walked by our house and noticed the garden in our front yard.
Maybe you've wondered: _what are you growing, why are you growing it, and why are you growing it **there**?_
We'd love to tell you all about it! So we made this webpage to do just that.
And maybe by the end of it, you might even wonder: _how can I start a garden like yours in my own yard?_

## About us

We're David and Kelly! We moved to the neighborhood in 2024.
